infant school teacher

Niece of CMY’s maid Harriet Spratt, she married (1883) William John Gibson (b.Peshawur 1853), clerk.

She was living at Elderfield during the 1871 census.

She was daughter of William Spratt (1819-1872) and Ann Bond (1820-1863). [marriage certificate and tree from Barrie Spratt]
